predictions.rationale: Defines the core "Critic" agent abstraction, including triggering, evaluation logic and message generation – fundamental to implementing design critics.
Central manager that holds the collection of Critic agents and coordinates their execution; likely oversees background processing of design critics.
Implements the control mechanism that schedules and fires critics during editing sessions, directly supporting continuous analysis.
Application-level class that starts the critic subsystem, probably launching the background thread that runs the Agency.
Represents individual design improvement suggestions produced by critics; core data structure for critic results.
Aggregates ToDoItem instances, providing storage and access to all active critic findings for the designer.
Tracks critics whose suggestions have been addressed, supporting management of critic lifecycle and reminders.
Allows composition of multiple simple critics into complex ones, refining critic behavior and extending feature capabilities.
UI action that toggles automatic critique processing, directly supporting user control over background critic execution.
Provides the default implementation of the control mechanism used by the critic subsystem, integrating critics with the rest of the cognitive framework.
